اعتقدتم (form VIII)
# اِعْتَقَدْتُمْ (iʕtaqadtum) /iʕ.ta.qad.tum/: second-person masculine plural past active of اِعْتَقَدَ (iʕtaqada)
# اُعْتُقِدْتُمْ (uʕtuqidtum) /uʕ.tu.qid.tum/: second-person masculine plural past passive of اِعْتَقَدَ (iʕtaqada)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
